title: It’s okay
text: It’s okay. The color isn’t as vibrant as I would have preferred, and there are three random white spots on it. It’s okay. Not something I’d personally recommend to a friend.

product_metadata.title: Lavish Home Metal Cutout, 34", White
features: SWEET MESSAGE - This lovely 3D metal cutout with peaceful wording makes the perfect stylish touch for your bedroom, kid's room, baby nursery wall or entryway! It has a beautiful message of relaxing sleep.

BEAUTIFULLY CRAFTED- This “Sweet Dreams” sign is made from laser-cut iron with sculptured flowers, leaves, and vines, and individually hand painted with a distressed white  finish. It’s a gorgeous accent piece that will beautifully complement your décor for many years to come.

EASY INSTALLATION- Conveniently wall mountable with holes for the included anchoring screws incorporated discreetly into the design, this word art is easy to install and will complement any style of design, from modern rustic to vintage farmhouse chic.

THE PERFECT GIFT- This elegant  word cutout is a fantastic gift for birthdays, engagements, weddings, housewarmings, new baby, holidays, or any occasion! Your interior design loving friends and family will adore this charming décor piece.
PRODUCT DETAILS- Materials: Laser cut iron metal with distressed white finish. Dimensions: (L)34”x (W)2”x (H)14.75”. Mounting hardware included.
description: The Metal Cutout “Sweet Dreams” Sign by Lavish Home is a beautiful addition to any home décor! With an attractive distressed white finish and floral scrollwork, this inspiring word art will complement any style of interior design, from modern rustic to vintage farmhouse chic. Perfect for home or spa space, this versatile and uplifting piece is a great touch for your bedroom, nursery or entryway.  Graceful arched branches and flowers enhance this wall art. This lovely wall mount 3D décor piece is a wonderful gift for birthdays, engagements, weddings, housewarmings, new baby, holidays, or any occasion!
